packages.label: נִגּוּן וְלֵוִי — הַנִּגּוּן כִּבְחִינַת הַהִתְחַבְּרוּת
packages.label_en: Melody and Levi — Music as the Aspect of Joining/Union
packages.reason: These concepts share the essential nature of 'joining and attachment between two things.' Levi IS melody (the Zohar states melody comes from the side of Levi). Melody and musical instruments ARE the bechina of union (hitḥabrut). The wedding instruments are this same bechina — a wedding IS the joining of two people, enacted through music. All four concepts are different expressions of the single underlying reality: the power of attachment and union. The linguistic root ל-ו-ה (Levi / yilaveh / musical accompaniment) unifies them explicitly in the text.

merge_notes.reason: These are explicitly identified as the same bechina as the above (וְזֶה בְּחִינַת כְּלֵי זֶמֶר שֶׁמְּנַגְּנִין עַל חֲתֻנָּה). The wedding and its music are not a separate domain — they are the concrete instantiation of the joining-through-melody principle. They belong to the same package.
